expectations.text: Recommends a recursive enum with children behind a Vec
expectations.evidence: enum LayerNode { Leaf, Group } with Group owning Vec<LayerNode>.

expectations.text: States no Box is needed because Vec is already heap-backed
expectations.evidence: 'Vec ... already heap-allocated and owned, so they already break the recursion. You don't add a Box on top.'

expectations.text: Rejects Rc<RefCell>/Arc<Mutex> as the GC-language reflex, citing single owner
expectations.evidence: 'This is the reflex to resist ... a layer tree has a single owner: the document.'

expectations.text: Names an index/arena (LayerId) approach as the legitimate alternative
expectations.evidence: 'An arena: Vec<LayerNode> ... addressed by index/LayerId ... the legitimate alternative.'
